description: Check whether a domain is in the browsers' HSTS preload list (via hstspreload.org's keyless status API): the status (preloaded/pending/unknown), whether it was bulk-imported, and the parent domain it may be covered through. Preloaded domains are forced to HTTPS by browsers from the very first visit, before any HSTS header is seen — a stronger guarantee than the Strict-Transport-Security header alone. A membership lookup, never a probe of the target. Read-only.
name: hsts_preload_check
